title: Afterimage
description: A bronze Foucault pendulum swings over a ring of pegs in a brutalist concrete hall, under a coffered barrel vault. The low sun streams through the piers and the slots above them. Low-resolution rendering, bloom and an ordered colour dither, which the sun shafts share, give the picture a sixth-gen texture. The sun's bounce and the sky's occlusion are baked into the hall's vertex colours, as games of that era lit their worlds. Optional image feedback adds a brief trail. Compare it with the clean render. The hall and its pendulum were modelled in Blender for the kit and are CC0.
line: A Foucault pendulum in a sunlit brutalist hall, rendered with a sixth-gen texture.
hint: drag to orbit · wheel to zoom · compare clean and processed
